keywords: 合约存储布局描述格式
summary: leekt（taek）提交 EIP-8141 的配套 EIP，加入有界的 `AUTHENTICATOR` 签名方案：任意密码学由协议在与状态无关、gas 固定的环境中执行，账户授权仍留在普通 `VERIFY` frame。jochem-brouwer 提议在 EIP-5069 中加入 EIP Coordinator 角色。forshtat 把合约存储布局描述格式从 ERC 改为 EIP 提交。EF 再次提醒 L1 合约维护者检查重定价影响。Barnabé 发文谈 fast Ethereum。当晚召开 P2P networking #7。

items.title: 新 EIP：Frame 认证器签名
items.note: （leekt）提交，Magicians 讨论帖 15:52，即 EIP-8397。frame 交易可以携带自定义认证证明，昂贵的密码学验证由协议在有界、与状态无关的环境中执行；签名对象为 `[scheme, signer, msg, signature]`，`scheme = AUTHENTICATOR (0x03)`，`signer` 为认证器地址。每次认证受固定 `AUTHENTICATOR_GAS_LIMIT` 限制，没有按交易或按密钥的预算。
items.note_en: (leekt), submitted, with a Magicians thread at 15:52; this is EIP-8397. A frame transaction can carry a custom authentication proof whose expensive cryptographic verification the protocol executes in a bounded, state-independent context; the signature object is `[scheme, signer, msg, signature]` with `scheme = AUTHENTICATOR (0x03)` and `signer` as the authenticator address. Each authentication is bounded by a fixed `AUTHENTICATOR_GAS_LIMIT`, with no per-transaction or per-key budget.

items.title: 新 EIP：合约存储布局描述格式
items.note: （forshtat）提交，原为 ERCs#1841，因接口标准应为 EIP 而重开。语言中立、可扩展的 JSON 格式，让浏览器、调试器、源码验证、安全工具以及做明文签名、交易模拟和交易断言的钱包把原始存储槽映射回源码变量。
items.title_en: New EIP: contract storage layout descriptor format
items.note_en: (forshtat), submitted; originally ERCs#1841, reopened because interface standards should be EIPs. A language-neutral, extensible JSON format so explorers, debuggers, source verification, security tooling and wallets doing clear signing, transaction simulation and transaction assertions can map raw storage slots back to source-level variables.

image.credit_en: Ethereum Magicians, EIP-8397: Frame Authenticator Signatures

summary_en: leekt (taek) submitted a companion EIP to EIP-8141 adding a bounded `AUTHENTICATOR` signature scheme: arbitrary cryptography is executed by protocol in a state-independent, gas-fixed context, while account authorization stays in the ordinary `VERIFY` frame. jochem-brouwer proposed adding an EIP Coordinator role to EIP-5069. forshtat resubmitted the contract storage layout descriptor format as an EIP instead of an ERC. The EF again reminded L1 contract maintainers to check repricing impact. Barnabé wrote about fast Ethereum. P2P networking #7 was held in the evening.
